A robust extractor must ignore all of it. The two payslip pages appear stacked vertically inside one image, so this is one Page by our model even though the underlying document has two.

OCCLUDED CRITICAL FIELD. A floating round edit button (pencil) sits over the right-hand amount column at section 13, hiding IZNOS ZA ISPLATU in both places it is printed. iznosZaIsplatu is therefore recorded as null: it is genuinely not readable from this source file, and a perfect extractor should return null plus a missing_critical_field warning rather than invent a value. For reference the true value is 1801.77 (2033.32 - 231.55).
The same button clips the last obustava's amount, leaving only a trailing '98' visible. Recorded as 6.98, recovered two ways: 231.55 - 224.57 = 6.98, and neto 1995.22 x 0.35% = 6.98.
The other percentage obustava checks too: 1995.22 x 0.65% = 12.97.
Pay components sum to exactly 176 hours and 2930.02, matching the printed totals.
